label: Grief
definition: Emotional response to loss; no defined end state.
notes: Not a need. Affects capability at every touchpoint; an FCA vulnerability driver.

label: Financial vulnerability
definition: Reduced income or increased outgoings following the death without a defined resolution point.
notes: Strongest for partner variants. FCA vulnerability driver.

label: Social isolation
definition: Loss of the deceased's social role with no defined resolution.

label: Changed household composition
notes: Structural condition for partner variants; drives downsizing and care moves.
